propositions: reconcile_helpers.py cannot be loaded standalone via reconcile.py because _commit_binding_store_snapshot() performs an unconditional top-level import of rebar_reconciler.git_adapter that fails when no parent package is available

the helper is documented to support package-free by-path execution and must return True/False for commit-back success/failure, but raises ModuleNotFoundError before reaching the no-state True or fail-open False branches

the git adapter import must be replaced with the existing sibling loader using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter to preserve both standalone and package-context execution paths sharing one sys.modules identity

standalone and package-context execution must resolve to the same canonical adapter module object while preserving all documented commit-back semantics (no-file True, successful-commit True, operational-failure False)
